verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents an official SDK, but only for Tap to Phone payments on iOS and Android. It also ships a JavaScript bundle framework for its embedded components. The OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec is a building block for generating clients, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit, and no general-purpose server-side SDKs are evidenced. Missing for 10: official server-side SDKs for the core API (e.g., Node/Python), SDK reference docs and versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Rainforest currently supports processing Tap to Phone payments utilizing the Rainforest SDK on iOS and Android devices.
Tap to Phone enables merchants to accept contactless payments directly on a compatible device.
This framework allows you to collect sensitive data without exposing your platform to card data, reducing your PCI DSS scope.
